changelog:
- YouTube Zero-Buffering & Startup Delay Fix: Eliminated XHR manifest re-serialization for /player, /next, /reel, and /browse, removing buffer stalls on watch, shorts, and feed playback.
- In-Flight Page-Side Defuser: Ad data defused in-place via Response.prototype.json and JSON.parse without stalling data streams.
- ABP-Style Network Filtering: Full support for ||host^ anchors, @@ exceptions, and path-scoped rules with boundary matching.
- Pure Android System WebView v2.1.9 release (17.4 MB).
